newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-UNINSPIRED MILAN HELD BY CORINTHIANS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNINSPIRED MILAN HELD BY CORINTHIANS.

text.p: AC Milan continued without a first win in the Copa Centenario as they were held to a 0-0 draw by Brazilians Corinthians in a game between two uninspiring teams on Monday.

The Italians, held 2-2 by local team Atletico Mineiro on Saturday, created only one good chance, when Liberian striker George Weah turned his marker but saw his shot saved by goalkeeper Ronaldo Giovanelli late in the second half.
Corinthians, who also drew for the second time in the competition, were equally toothless, showing why they have managed only eight goals in seven games in the Brazilian championship.
